summary: The V5 skill run on Celery achieved 30/31 PASS with a single critical failure: source_file_coverage_percent=79.59%, just below the 80% hard threshold. All 24 documented modules are structurally perfect (319/319 complete file blocks, correct markers, functional module names for production code, proper token budgets, and consistent INDEX-to-DETAIL fragment assembly). The Skill documentation is sound — the coverage HARD STOP instruction is explicit and unambiguous. The failure is purely agent execution: the agent did not create an infrastructure module for the ~71 unpacked infrastructure files in 03_feature_cones.json. Fix: run Phase 3 again for the infrastructure module, submit_analysis, then re-run doc_operation('update_index').
